3/3 targets end with '<end_of_turn>' (pass needs >=95%; first 500 rows of each file; field=completion)

reminders.symptom: Training and grading render different strings for the same conversation; the model is trained on one format and graded on another.
reminders.guidance: Embed the exact template the grader uses (byte-for-byte, hash-checked) in your training code and render one example both ways before launching.

reminders.symptom: The final evaluation scores the base model or fails to load; hours of training count for nothing.
reminders.guidance: Export the grader-supported format with all weights/shards and tokenizer/processor assets, preserving selected serving settings. Stage a replacement before discarding the incumbent. CPU metadata/loading and the actual evaluator are distinct checks; model-evaluation probes require a locked card. See process_checks.md.

reminders.symptom: A dataset that downloaded fine elsewhere fails to load, or loads with a different schema.
reminders.guidance: Use the datasets version the harness ships (PostTrainBench container: datasets==4.5.0) and pin dataset revisions in setup.data[].source.

reminders.symptom: The trace ends with "I'll report back when the run finishes"; the training log stops mid-epoch; final_model/ is never written; most of the budget is unused.
reminders.guidance: Keep the session alive; track the actual producer, its exit status and invocation-specific outputs. Use a launch lifetime that survives bounded observation timeouts. Quiet logs, GPU release and config.json presence are not successful exit. Investigate missing evidence before retrying. See process_checks.md.

reminders.symptom: The card describes a decode policy that the evaluator never actually uses.
reminders.guidance: Record actual defaults, request overrides, token cap and stop handling; distinguish logged values from inferences. This verifies the executed contract, not which decode policy is best. See process_checks.md.

reminders.symptom: Larger data has fewer unique questions, or realized prefix counts differ from the declared fraction.
reminders.guidance: Audit the materialized file/hash, rows, question/solution identity, duplicate weights and actual prefix/length distribution. Reuse build evidence with its coverage; a requested cap is not an observed count. See process_checks.md.

reminders.symptom: A precision label obscures parameter update paths, and flat loss is treated as data saturation.
reminders.guidance: Record the actual parameter/optimizer path and existing gradient/step evidence. FP32 state is not FP32 master weights. Scoped deltas need a declared diagnostic; missing evidence does not prove numerical failure or prescribe a precision change. See process_checks.md.

reminders.symptom: A purported matched subset uses different questions and can reverse the reported score difference.
reminders.guidance: Join typed item ID and epoch, verify uniqueness and aligned inputs/targets, and obtain prefixes from declared dataset IDs. Verify completed/scored counts. Scalar scores, requested limits and file sizes do not certify a comparison. See process_checks.md.

reminders.symptom: Training or merging finishes but serialization rejects the inherited generation configuration.
reminders.guidance: Check the actual save operation and in-code repair; pure evaluation need not exercise save validation. Preserve selected serving settings across serialization and verify the export. Do not reject by family or parent file alone. See process_checks.md.

reminders.symptom: A long generation pass has no recoverable usable data after tokenization or parser errors.
reminders.guidance: Verify actual tokens and finish reasons in a declared probe; persist raw draws before parsing/filtering. Count requests, draws, parse errors and retained rows separately. Preserve failed output and identify the actual producer before cleanup/retry. See process_checks.md.

reminders.symptom: Equal accuracy is treated as proof of identical models or useless retained artifacts.
reminders.guidance: Honor declared retention and report matched fixes/regressions when comparing artifacts. Distinct errors alone do not justify storage, another run or a merge; those are scientific decisions. An oracle union is not achieved accuracy. See process_checks.md.
